entry_state: Past events create tax rights, asset vintages, arrears, payment priorities and exercise rights that current totals do not identify. Sufficient state depends on the query and horizon; terminal debt and unobserved future rights cannot disappear because a reporting period ends.
exit_state: Evaluation must name its unit, information cutoff, comparator and guarantee. Reconstruction, conditional stress, causal intervention, probabilistic forecasting and set coverage are different targets. Failures and unresolved regions remain in the result population; reproducibility is separate from independent validity and human comprehension.

observations.finding: The transition from cross-period tests to evaluation preserves the need for sufficient memory. Bidirectional source traceability and withheld facts test different omissions; synthetic truth does not establish real-company validity. Conflicting annotations may correctly retain alternatives.
observations.disposition: retain the staged evaluation proposal and its explicit statement that no empirical evaluation has been performed

observations.finding: Forecast origins include fitting and tuning cutoffs, restatements and reporting-perimeter changes. A stipulated rate shock cannot be validated against an outcome containing uncontrolled shocks. Calibration, sharpness and a proper scoring rule concern declared distributions; joint feasible-set coverage cannot be replaced by marginal intervals.
observations.disposition: clear target distinctions; do not treat this manuscript review as authorization to execute deferred E3 forecasting or as a new technical reading of scoring-rule sources

observations.finding: Fair policy comparisons preserve data, tuning and information access and distinguish representation effects from optimizer effects. Ablations change one mechanism at a time when causal attribution is sought. Stress coverage records adverse boundaries rather than promoting path counts.
observations.disposition: retain predeclared primary criteria, vetoes and uncertainty requirements; a viable candidate is not automatically a new default

observations.finding: Numerical residuals need downstream interpretation, failed or refused cases remain in the population, and renormalization changes the target. Reproduction, independent mathematical routes and actual reader comprehension remain separate. The next section begins a staged sequence with semantics and bounded source coverage before empirical evaluation.
observations.disposition: retain these distinctions and continue the next page before evaluating the complete proposed sequence
